description: This PHP class defines the 'Workshop' model for a software project, including properties, data fetching methods, relationships, and persistence logic related to workshops within the application.

classes.name: Workshop
classes.description: Represents a workshop entity with properties, relationships, and methods for data retrieval, validation, and persistence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Workshop instance, setting default language if not specified.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of language-specific fields.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific workshop by ID, with optional language parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all workshops matching optional filters.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Gets a paginated list of workshops, with optional filtering and counting.

methods.name: getSpheres
methods.description: Retrieves associated spheres for the workshop.

methods.name: getStories
methods.description: Retrieves related stories for the workshop.

methods.name: getPosts
methods.description: Retrieves posts related to the workshop.

methods.name: getSponsors
methods.description: Retrieves sponsors for the workshop, filtered by type.

methods.name: getHeaderImage
methods.description: Returns the header image instance for the workshop.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Fetches the call object associated with the workshop.

methods.name: expired
methods.description: Determines if the workshop has expired based on current date.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns location details for the workshop.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the workshop data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates essential properties of the workshop instance.
